blockers: Semgrep eval() code execution in contributions.js:32-34
attack_story: An attacker exploits the NoSQL injection in allocations-dao.js to manipulate database queries, then uses vulnerable dependencies (e.g., prototype pollution in lodash/minimist) to escalate privileges or execute arbitrary code. They steal the hardcoded private key from server.key to decrypt sensitive data or impersonate the server. The eval() code execution in contributions.js provides another entry point for system compromise. All critical dependencies (bson, tar, etc.) could enable remote code execution or denial-of-service attacks once initial access is achieved.
